    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.residents r
      where r.unit_id = units.id
        and r.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

  for select to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.building_staff bs
      where bs.building_id = (
        select u.building_id
        from public.units u
        where u.id = residents.unit_id
      )
        and bs.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );
